blocks.text: North Meadows homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

North Meadows, September 2026. Detached houses: 1 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 200%. Condos and townhomes: 9 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 22%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 2 over 4 months against an average of 2.0 listed, about 4.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 2 sold. condos and townhomes sold 4 over 4 months against an average of 8.2 listed, about 8.2 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 2 sold.
